listing.name: Hotel Mario — hotel-mario-static-recomp (tools81)
listing.summary: A native player and enhancement options are available. Support for individual stages, a full campaign and completion is unconfirmed. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA raw BIN/CUE disc. The required executable and module hashes are not listed here; check upstream’s source profile before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use the portable Windows x64 ZIP or installer described in the README and supply your own disc when asked; that player package needs no compiler. The separate source build.bat route extracts and translates modules, then builds standard and HD executables.

warnings: A native player and enhancement options are available. Support for individual stages, a full campaign and completion is unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
